user.title: Machine with Poweroff
user.description: Poweroff (Jorgen Bosman) must run on the Windows machine with remote control enabled.

data_description.host: Name or IP address of the machine.
data_description.password: Remote control password; empty if none is set.

error.cannot_connect: Poweroff does not answer. Is the machine on and Poweroff's remote control enabled?

abort.already_configured: This machine is already set up.

data_description.warning_seconds: 0 = act immediately without a warning on the machine.
data_description.force: Close programs even if they ask to save.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Lets Poweroff perform an action on its machine right away.

config_entry_id.name: Machine
config_entry_id.description: The Poweroff entry of the machine.

warning_seconds.name: Warning
warning_seconds.description: Seconds of warning on the machine; empty = setting of the entry.

message.name: Warning text
message.description: Shown during the warning; empty = setting of the entry.

force.name: Force
force.description: Force programs to close; empty = setting of the entry.

simulate.name: Simulate only
simulate.description: Poweroff only shows on the machine what it would do; the window there must be closed, otherwise it blocks the next shutdown.

entry_not_found.message: No Poweroff entry with this ID.
